scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @studnet/api" "npm run dev -w @studnet/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @studnet/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @studnet/web
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:api && npm run build:worker && npm run build:web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @studnet/shared && npm run typecheck -w @studnet/api && npm run typecheck -w @studnet/worker && npm run typecheck -w @studnet/web
scripts.db:setup: npm run prisma:deploy && npm run db:seed
